title: Genomics & Multi-Omics
blurb: Germline and cancer genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, single-cell atlases and GWAS summary statistics.

items.name: NCI Genomic Data Commons (TCGA & more)
items.description: Harmonised genomic and clinical data from TCGA (33 cancer types, ~11,000 patients), TARGET, CPTAC and other NCI programmes, with web portal and API.
items.access_note: Open tier (clinical, expression, somatic mutation calls) freely downloadable; raw reads and germline data need dbGaP authorisation.

paper.label: Grossman RL et al. N Engl J Med 2016;375:1109

items.name: cBioPortal for Cancer Genomics
items.description: Interactive portal for exploring and downloading processed multidimensional cancer genomics datasets from 400+ studies, with clinical annotations.
items.provider: Memorial Sloan Kettering / Dana-Farber / Princess Margaret

paper.label: Cerami E et al. Cancer Discov 2012;2:401

items.name: ICGC ARGO
items.description: International Cancer Genome Consortium platform with clinically annotated tumour genomes from >100,000 patients (successor to the PCAWG/ICGC 25K data).
items.access_note: Open-tier summary data browsable; controlled data require application through DACO.

paper.label: ICGC/TCGA PCAWG Consortium. Nature 2020;578:82

items.name: COSMIC
items.full_name: Catalogue Of Somatic Mutations In Cancer
items.description: Expert-curated database of somatic mutations in human cancer, including Cancer Gene Census, mutational signatures and drug-resistance mutations.
items.access_note: Free for academic/non-profit use with registration; commercial use licensed.

paper.label: Tate JG et al. Nucleic Acids Res 2019;47:D941

items.name: 1000 Genomes / IGSR
items.description: Whole-genome sequences of 3,202 individuals from 26 populations, the reference catalogue of human genetic variation maintained by the International Genome Sample Resource.

paper.label: 1000 Genomes Project Consortium. Nature 2015;526:68

items.name: gnomAD
items.description: Allele frequencies and constraint metrics from >800,000 exomes and genomes across diverse ancestries — essential for variant interpretation.
items.access_note: Open browser and downloads (VCF, Hail tables) on public clouds.

paper.label: Karczewski KJ et al. Nature 2020;581:434

items.name: TOPMed BRAVO
items.description: Variant browser and allele frequencies from >150,000 deeply sequenced genomes in NHLBI's TOPMed programme; individual-level data via dbGaP.
items.access_note: Browser requires a free Google login; individual data by dbGaP application.

paper.label: Taliun D et al. Nature 2021;590:290

items.name: ClinVar
items.description: Public archive of relationships between human genetic variants and phenotypes with supporting evidence and clinical-significance assertions from labs worldwide.

paper.label: Landrum MJ et al. Nucleic Acids Res 2018;46:D1062

items.name: GWAS Catalog
items.description: Curated collection of all published genome-wide association studies with >600,000 variant–trait associations and full summary statistics for many studies.

paper.label: Sollis E et al. Nucleic Acids Res 2023;51:D977

items.name: PGS Catalog
items.description: Open database of published polygenic scores with variant weights, metadata and performance metrics for thousands of traits.

paper.label: Lambert SA et al. Nat Genet 2021;53:420

items.name: FinnGen (summary statistics)
items.description: GWAS summary statistics for ~2,400 disease endpoints from ~500,000 Finnish biobank participants linked to national health registries.
items.access_note: Summary statistics free to download after filling a short form; individual data not shared.

paper.label: Kurki MI et al. Nature 2023;613:508

items.name: Pan-UK Biobank (summary statistics)
items.description: Multi-ancestry GWAS summary statistics for >7,000 phenotypes in UK Biobank across six continental ancestry groups — free, even though UK Biobank itself is fee-based.

items.name: GTEx Portal
items.description: Gene expression and eQTLs across 54 non-diseased tissues from ~1,000 post-mortem donors, showing how genetic variation regulates expression.
items.access_note: Expression and eQTL results open; raw genotypes and reads via dbGaP.

paper.label: GTEx Consortium. Science 2020;369:1318

items.name: ENCODE
items.description: Encyclopedia of DNA Elements: functional genomics data (ChIP-seq, ATAC-seq, RNA-seq, Hi-C) mapping regulatory elements across human and mouse cell types.

paper.label: ENCODE Project Consortium. Nature 2012;489:57

items.name: Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO)
items.description: NCBI's public repository of >200,000 functional-genomics studies (microarray, RNA-seq, methylation, single-cell) submitted with publications.

paper.label: Barrett T et al. Nucleic Acids Res 2013;41:D991

items.name: ArrayExpress (BioStudies)
items.description: EMBL-EBI archive of functional-genomics experiments — Europe's counterpart to GEO — now served through the BioStudies platform.

items.name: Sequence Read Archive (SRA)
items.description: The largest public repository of raw high-throughput sequencing reads, with cloud-hosted copies on AWS and Google Cloud.
items.access_note: Open for most data; human controlled-access reads via dbGaP.

items.name: dbGaP
items.description: NIH archive of individual-level genotype, sequence and phenotype data from >1,500 studies (e.g. Framingham, TOPMed, GTEx raw data).
items.access_note: Free; eRA Commons login and Data Access Committee approval per study. Public summaries open.

paper.label: Mailman MD et al. Nat Genet 2007;39:1181

items.name: European Genome-phenome Archive (EGA)
items.description: Repository of controlled-access human genetic and phenotypic data from biomedical studies worldwide (e.g. H3Africa, many cancer cohorts).
items.access_note: Free; request access from each dataset's Data Access Committee.

paper.label: Freeberg MA et al. Nucleic Acids Res 2022;50:D980

items.name: Human Cell Atlas Data Portal
items.description: Single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data from millions of cells across human tissues, contributing to a reference map of every cell type.

paper.label: Regev A et al. eLife 2017;6:e27041

items.name: CZ CELLxGENE Discover
items.description: Curated, standardised collection of 1,000+ single-cell datasets (100M+ cells) with in-browser exploration and a Python/R Census API.

items.name: Human Protein Atlas
items.description: Maps of protein expression across human tissues, cells, organelles, blood and cancers using antibody-based imaging and transcriptomics.

paper.label: Uhlén M et al. Science 2015;347:1260419

items.name: Proteomic Data Commons (CPTAC)
items.description: Mass-spectrometry proteomics and phosphoproteomics data from CPTAC tumour cohorts, harmonised and linked to GDC genomic data.

items.name: PRIDE Archive
items.description: The world's largest repository of mass-spectrometry proteomics data, part of the ProteomeXchange consortium.

paper.label: Perez-Riverol Y et al. Nucleic Acids Res 2022;50:D543

items.name: MetaboLights
items.description: Cross-species, cross-technique repository for metabolomics experiments with raw spectra, metadata and reference metabolite information.

paper.label: Yurekten O et al. Nucleic Acids Res 2024;52:D640

items.name: Human Microbiome Project
items.description: Metagenomic and 16S data from body sites of healthy adults (HMP1) and multi-omic disease cohorts (iHMP: IBD, prediabetes, pregnancy).

paper.label: Human Microbiome Project Consortium. Nature 2012;486:207

items.name: DepMap Portal
items.description: Cancer Dependency Map: CRISPR/RNAi gene-dependency screens, drug sensitivity and multi-omic profiles for 1,000+ cancer cell lines (incl. CCLE).

paper.label: Tsherniak A et al. Cell 2017;170:564

items.name: GDSC
items.full_name: Genomics of Drug Sensitivity in Cancer
items.description: Drug-response data for ~1,000 cancer cell lines against hundreds of anticancer compounds, with genomic markers of sensitivity.

paper.label: Yang W et al. Nucleic Acids Res 2013;41:D955

items.name: Open Targets Platform
items.description: Integrates genetics, omics, literature and drug data to score and prioritise target–disease associations for drug discovery.
items.provider: Open Targets (EMBL-EBI, Wellcome Sanger, industry partners)
items.access_note: Open web, GraphQL API and bulk downloads.

paper.label: Ochoa D et al. Nucleic Acids Res 2023;51:D1353

items.name: ImmPort
items.description: Repository of immunology study data (clinical trials and mechanistic studies) from NIAID-funded research, curated into a standard model.
items.access_note: Free registration and acceptance of the data-use agreement.

paper.label: Bhattacharya S et al. Sci Data 2018;5:180015

items.name: DECIPHER
items.description: Database of genomic variants and phenotypes from ~50,000 consented patients with rare developmental disorders, used for variant interpretation.
items.access_note: Open-access records browsable; bulk download under a data access agreement.

paper.label: Firth HV et al. Am J Hum Genet 2009;84:524

items.name: PGC Psychiatric GWAS Summary Statistics
items.description: Genome-wide association summary statistics for schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, depression, ADHD, autism and other psychiatric disorders.
items.access_note: Direct download (most results); also mirrored on Hugging Face.

items.name: Tahoe-100M
items.description: 100 million single-cell transcriptomic profiles of cancer cell lines under ~1,100 drug perturbations — the largest single-cell perturbation atlas.
